## 1. Biography & Professional Philosophy

Harsh Gupta is an engineer and multidisciplinary product creator with a rare blend of abilities spanning:
1. **Front-End & Full-Stack Web Development**: Building high-speed, aesthetically refined web apps using React, Next.js, TypeScript, and modern styling libraries.
2. **Cloudflare Edge Infrastructure**: Deploying serverless micro-apps on Cloudflare Workers, Cloudflare D1 (SQL at the edge), Cloudflare R2 object storage, and Durable Objects for real-time collaboration.
3. **Embedded Systems & IoT**: Designing microcontroller hardware (ESP32, ESP8266, Raspberry Pi Pico), writing firmware (C/C++, CircuitPython), and building wireless communication bridges (MQTT, WebSockets, Bluetooth LE).
4. **Physical Product Design & Rapid Prototyping**: Engineering 3D printable enclosures and mechanical parts in CAD (Fusion 360), optimizing FDM/SLA prints, and assembling end-to-end hardware-software products.

Rather than being confined to screen-only software or breadboard-only hardware, Harsh builds entire products from circuit board to user interface.

## 2. Technical Stack & Competencies

### Frontend
- **Languages**: TypeScript, JavaScript (ES2024), HTML5, CSS3 / Modern CSS
- **Frameworks & Libraries**: React, Next.js, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, Redux Toolkit
- **Design & UX**: Figma, Adobe XD, Design Systems, Mobile-First Responsive Design, WCAG 2.2 AA Accessibility

### Backend & Cloud
- **Cloud & Edge**: Cloudflare Workers, Cloudflare Pages, Cloudflare D1 (Distributed SQLite), Cloudflare R2, Durable Objects, AWS (S3, Lambda, CloudFront)
- **APIs & Protocols**: RESTful APIs, WebSockets, GraphQL, WebBot Auth, JSON-LD Structured Data
- **Databases & Auth**: SQL, SQLite, Supabase, PostgreSQL, JWT, Session-based auth

### Hardware, Embedded & IoT
- **Microcontrollers**: ESP32, ESP8266, Raspberry Pi Pico, Arduino Uno/Nano, STM32
- **Firmware & Code**: C, C++, CircuitPython, MicroPython, Arduino Framework
- **Protocols & Buses**: I2C, SPI, UART, GPIO, MQTT, HTTP/REST, BLE, WiFi
- **Sensors & Actuators**: Ultrasonic sensors, GPS modules (NEO-6M), IMUs/Accelerometers, Temperature/Humidity, Relays, OLED/TFT Displays, Stepper & Servo Motors
- **Mechanical & Fabrication**: FDM 3D Printing (Snapmaker, Voron), CAD (Autodesk Fusion 360), Slicing (OrcaSlicer, PrusaSlicer, Cura)
